To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the deductibility of commuting expenses is a second-best-optimal policy if labor is immobile, but not a first-best optimal policy if labor is perfectly mobile.
the deductibility of commuting expenses is not justified by a second-best-optimal tax approach and that it is likely to be the outcome of political pressure.
